brief:
Hana al-Zabda, a cheesemaker in Gaza, continues her craft as an act of resistance against the devastation of war. Working amid the conflict, she produces cheese using traditional methods, maintaining her livelihood and cultural practice despite the broader hardships facing the territory.

Al-Zabda's work represents a determination to preserve normalcy and economic activity in the face of displacement and loss, the Ma'an news agency reported. Her cheese production serves as both a means of survival and a statement against the erosion of daily life in Gaza.
title: Gaza woman makes cheese to resist loss amid war
